capabilities: Store encrypted objects locally or via gateway
disambiguation: It is not a general-purpose encryption tool; it specifically manages the visibility of metadata within the Obsidian note structure.
extras: Mobile acceptance is deferred. Standalone mode performs no network requests. Gateway mode requires HTTPS for non-loopback endpoints.
intentEvidence: CipherLink creates encrypted Markdown notes in Obsidian while keeping user-selected metadata and relationships visible to native search, tags, backlinks, and Graph view.
problem: Users need a way to keep sensitive note content encrypted while maintaining visibility and functionality for Obsidian's native search, tags, and graph views.
summary: CipherLink creates encrypted Markdown notes in Obsidian, allowing selected metadata and relationships to remain visible for native search and graph views.
